snippet.title: Behind the Scenes - Catwoman (2004 PS2/Xbox Game) | Halle Berry Interview
snippet.description:
Halle Berry talk about her involvement with the development of the game based on the movie Catwoman, developed by Argonaut Games and released in 2004 for Playstation 2, Xbox, GameCube and PC.

Source: PSW magazine bonus disc
